: Ahem.
scene kirinxmad1
: I said...ahem!
: Uhh...
: Bless you?
scene kirinxmad2
: That was a cough, not a sneeze!
: Do you...want me to ask Touka if she has any NyQuil or something?
: No, idiot! I want you to apologize to me so we can go back to being normal again and put an end to all this frustrating tension!
: Oh. My bad. Apologize for what, though?
scene kirinxmad3
: I can’t really remember. Something with my sister, I think.
: You mean that time I tackled her to the ground and completely ruined my relationship with her? The one that I already informed you about?
: I don’t know. Probably.
: Well, what else would it be? Because I-
: We can just call it the Karin thing and be done with it. I’m waiting.
: So...Wait, I still don’t really get what I’m apologizing for. You already know what happened. We even had sex afterward.
: Yeah. But it wasn’t even, like...that enjoyable.
: You came like six times.
scene kirinxmad2
: Four! Now, stop making me yell! It’s embarrassing!
: Kirin, what are you doing?
scene kirinxmad4

: I don’t know, okay?! Like, I’m mad at you for some reason! But I don’t fully understand it and I don’t want to go back to normal like nothing happened! But I also don’t want to stop spending time with you!
: That sounds both extremely complicated and extremely on-par with your character thus far.
: Feeling bad isn’t supposed to be a part of my character! I’m the cool sex-friend! Feelings are for people like Ayane and Noriko! Not me!
: So...what do you want me to do? Take you into some secret room and fuck you back to normal or something?
: Yes! But only after you apologize and things go back to normal.
: Kirin, you’re the one making things abnormal right now. I’m completely fine with going back to the way we were whenever you want. You’re the one who’s been avoiding me.
: Why?!
: Why...are you avoiding me?
scene kirinxmad5
: Yeah! Like...why would I do that?
: If I had to take a guess, you’re probably just pissed off at me for what I did to your sister because you secretly love her.
: No. That’s ridiculous. It has to be something else.
: Okay. So you’re totally cool with me fucking her then?
scene kirinxmad8
: Don’t even fucking-
scene kirinxmad6
: Oh my God. That is what it is.
: You really didn’t know that?
: No! I’m not supposed to be like this!
: Like, yes. I like you now. I have accepted that. It’s a thing. But literally anyone with half a brain would want to bone Karin and it doesn’t make sense for me to be mad if-
: Kirin, you’re not mad because I want to bone Karin. You’re mad because I upset her and you care about her.
scene kirinxmad7
: No, because why would I want you to apologize to me then?
: You don’t. You’re just dumb.
scene kirinxmad8
: And you’re an asshole!
: I sure am.
: So, are we back to normal yet?
: If I say yes, can we go talk somewhere more private so everyone isn’t looking at me anymore?
: No one is looking at you. I put up my anti-eavesdropping barrier that I break out whenever I have private conversations in crowded rooms. So there really isn’t any reason to go somewhere more-
scene black
: Shut up! We’re going somewhere else.
: Okay, but you’re underestimating how large this place is and we’re totally going to get lost.
scene kirinxmad9
: We’ll be fine. I downloaded the Tsukioka Manor navigation app.
: Oh, right. That’s a thing. I’m telling you though, we really don’t need to-
: You don’t have some kind of forcefield, Sensei! Now, give me your hand!
: We’re holding hands too?
: No! I’m simply pulling you along!
: With interlaced fingers? Is that really necessary?
: It’s so you can’t get away!
: ...what do you think about that, Chika?
scene kirinxmad10
: I think that doesn’t look like “love” at all.
: ...What?
: We were talking about Secret Santa. What doesn’t look like-
scene black
: Tick tock.
scene kirinxmad11
Kirin drags me through Tsukioka Manor until we reach an area almost entirely devoid of life, save the straggling butler and occasional maid.
It seems the entire place is decorated for Christmas, though. So it’s hard finding a space to remind her that we don’t live in a beautiful, happy world where everything can always go the way we want.
It’s something the two of us know, sure. But it’s also something we delude ourselves into thinking isn’t the case at times because escapism comes easier than accepting that.
I’ve been fine with being avoided by her. Because, on one hand, my absence in regard to anyone is nothing short of an improvement.
But even if she was pained by it, the idea of her being crushed by the weight of her sisterly love or whatever you want to call it seemed even greater. Just in a good way.

Of course, that was never meant to last. She can love her sister and think that she loves me. And I can encourage her or bully her or do whatever it takes to turn her on since it’s different any given day.
We’ll end up on a bed again soon. We’ll tell each other we’re bad people...then kiss or something. And it’ll feel great. But it’ll also feel empty.
It’s kind of like waking up Christmas morning and finding a bunch of presents with nothing in them.
Box after box of unrealized joy, because it’s never been what’s on the inside that counts. It’s always been the wrapping.
She wore a bow for me today.
I can not wait to open her.
: Do you...really think I love my sister?
: I’d be extremely surprised if you didn’t.
: Oh? And why is that?
: Because we’re alike.
: We both pretend not to care as much as we actually do. And while I’m sure the reasons for that are different, I can understand the basics like the back of my hand. It just...keeps things easier.
: I guess it...doesn’t sound like the end of the world when you put it that way.
: Yeah...
: You wouldn’t believe how the end of the world really looks.
scene kirinxmad12
: Hah...I could be talked into believing anything right now with how...all over the place I’ve been lately.
: This has been eating at me more than you probably know. And, like...it’s so fucking dumb. Like, why am I more hung up on it than she is?
: Because it’s the first time I’ve hurt anyone really close to you.
: You hurt Noriko like every fucking week.
: Yeah, but Karin is different. You’ve known her your whole life.
: You’ve seen firsthand just how much of a ball of sunshine she is. Faulting you for cursing my solar eclipse of an existence helps nothing or no one at all.
: I’ve always hated the sun.
: That’s not true. You thrive during all of our beach trips.
: Only when you’re around. But that’s because I have to if I want to stand out.
: Do you have any idea how fucking...difficult it is having to compare myself to her every day, though?
: I want nothing more than to just...be able to fucking hate her because I have no shortage of reasons to. But she...
: Karin puts me before everyone.
: That has to be why she didn’t tell me. She knows how much you mean to me and she...didn’t want to shatter that image when, like you said, nothing technically happened.
: Why do I mean so much to you, Kirin?
: I don’t know...
: Is it just because I give you attention?
scene kirinxmad13
: Well, why do you like me?
scene kirinxmad14
: If you even...do like me, I mean.
: Of course I like you.
: Well, it’s sure as fuck not because I give you attention then. You get that from fucking everyone.
: Yet it fixes nothing.
scene kirinxmad12
: Even if everyone ever starts looking at you, Kirin...
: If you get all the attention you’ve ever dreamed of...If you become that “perfect girl” you see your sister as...
: You’re not going to be any happier. Because that’s when you’ll pivot to not thinking you deserve it.
: So I’m just doomed to fucking hate myself for the rest of my life then?
: It’ll get easier to stop hating yourself when you stop trying so hard to be liked.
scene kirinxmad15
: Is that what you’re doing then? Just...trying to get people to like you?
: Or hate me. Depends on the mood I’m in.
: Seems to always backfire though since I’ve done that with you and you’re still interested in me for whatever reason you’ve landed on.
scene kirinxmad16
: Yeah...
: If almost raping my sister didn’t make me want to leave you behind, I’m worried nothing will.
: I’ve never felt that strongly about anyone before. It’s scary.
: Now imagine you keep feeling it.
: And imagine every time you do, there’s something else that shows up out of nowhere and pulls it away.
scene kirinxmad17
: So you try to chase after it...even when you know you’ll never catch up. And you’re aware that it would be so much easier to just stop and...find something similar, but you can’t.
: Until you can. But then that gets pulled away too.
: I wish I was you.

: I wish I could just...not feel strongly about anyone or anything. But that’s only because I’ve been beaten down by how it feels to do the opposite to the point where I can barely even breathe nowadays.
scene kirinxmad18
: Woah there, friend! Perhaps it’s time you ease back on all the melodrama? It’s Christmas after all! Today’s not the day to get all sentimental like this. You’re probably boring the poor girl!
: Yeah...you’re probably right.
: Kirin doesn’t care about what happened to me. She doesn’t care about the steps I took and all of the shit I fell over to get here.
: She only cares about how I make her feel. The rest is just noise.
: I’m a tool, like everything else. One that she can use to make herself grow.
: Now you’re getting it!
: And one day...many years from now, if we ever manage to get there, I’m sure she’ll look back on all of this as a great learning experience.
: She’ll regret letting me do what I did to her. She’ll regret feeling this strongly at all. She’ll regret me.
: I just hope she doesn’t have to go through what it’s like to have me plucked from her hands.
: Oh, Akira. How have you fallen so far? Your eyes were so bright when you were young.
: Don’t you remember all the time we spent together? Were we plucked from your memories as well? Or were we simply casualties of time itself while you moved on and became an adult?
: An adult?...
: Is that what you think I am?
scene kirinxmad19
: I have not grown...a day in my life.
: It’s all just a lie I tell myself to sleep better at night.
: But when even my lying doesn’t help put me to sleep anymore, what’s there left to do?
: Stop...
: Stop what? I-
scene kirinxmad20
: Sorry, Kirin.
: I’m seeing things today.
: Well, whatever you’re seeing isn’t right! I don’t think you’re a tool at all! It’s not like that!
: Our entire relationship is built on you storming into my office and trying to sell me your virginity.
scene kirinxmad21
: Who gives a shit about what it’s built on?! That’s not what it is anymore!
: Tons of shit has happened since then and...now I...Sensei, I-
: Don’t say it...
: Fuck you! I want to feel this for once! You don’t get to take that from me!
: I’m tired of nothing ever being enough! And I’m tired of forcing myself to not feel things! But if that’s going to make me end up like you, fuck it! I’ll feel everything ever right fucking now!
: Don’t, Kirin...
: I...love you.
scene kirinxmad22
: I won’t regret anything about whatever this is...or whatever it winds up being.
: If it’s just history when everything is said and done, then...fine. I’ll deal with that when it happens.
: But that other thing you said...about not wanting something to pluck you from my hands?...
: What the fuck, Sensei?...
: I’m supposed to be the one depriving myself of experiences and now you want to do that for me? Once I’m finally starting to accept that I shouldn’t?
: Maybe I’m just the tool then? Maybe I’m the one who-
: I love you too.
scene kirinxmad23
: What?...
: Why do you think I didn’t want you to say it?
: You...
: Maybe we should run away?
: Because even if we’re forced back here in the end, it sounds like something that could be good for us.
: A way to...deceive ourselves into thinking we’re decent people when we’re really just two perpetual train wrecks.
: You...love me?...
: I shouldn’t.
: But...you do.
: You’re not just saying that.
: Yeah.
: Okay...
: Why?
: Why what?
: Why do you love me? I’ve been terrible basically the entire time I’ve known you. Was starting to own up to that really all it took to-
: I think I have for a while, if we’re being honest.
: And you just...
: You just...kept that to yourself. Didn’t think it was at all relevant to me.
: I just want you to hate me.
: I’m tired of falling, Kirin. I just want someone to put me out of my misery at this point.
: Let’s do it.
: Run away? Or put me out of my misery?

: Neither. Let’s like, literally do it. Because I’m feeling extremely emotional right now and I feel like the only way I can get better is by seeing what it feels like to “make love” instead of “fuck” for once.
: It’s more or less the same at the end of the day. The only thing that changes is the monologue.
: Is that why all I can hear inside of my head right now is screaming?
: It’ll go away in time.
: Are we doing it or not?
: We-
: Trick question. The answer is yes.
: Kirin-
: You can “Kirin” me all you want later.
scene black
: I want this moment to be a good one for once...
scene kirinxmad24
She kisses differently when she’s happy.
Both times I’ve experienced it, she’s been wearing this dress.
Maybe it’s good luck. Or maybe it’s just something about the way it fits her that makes me want to chop her into pieces and box her up so she can stay by my side forever.
It’s hard to explain how I’m feeling right now. But it’s like that any time I fall for anyone.
Like Kirin, though, I’m tired.
I’m tired of doubting myself when it comes to things like this. I’m tired of being one step away from “happy” just to lose my footing after pretending to see a copperhead.
By all rights, Kirin Kanda is a terrible person.
By all wrongs, I have fallen for her.
May the two of us be banished to hell — for it is the only place we’d be accepted.
: Mmnh! Mm! Again...
: I love you...
: I love you! Mmnch! Sensei! I love you!
: Mmh! Mnh! Again!
: Kirin...
: Again!
: Ahem.
scene kirinxmad25
: Oh...shit.
: Hi?
: Oh, don’t mind me.
: I’ll just watch.
: Can you, like...not?
: Chika-
scene kirinxmad26

: You know, I was kinda worried that maybe Sensei had been lying to me about only fucking girls he loves when the two of you left the room together! But now I know he wasn’t! Further proof that I’m winning!
: W...Winning? What are you-

: You should probably stop crying if you’re about to fuck, though. Sensei has this thing about not sticking it in girls with tears in their eyes and, while I get that sex is emotional and stuff, maaaaaaybe get over it?
: How do you even-
scene kirinxmad27
: Because I’m your perfect girlfriend! How else would I know something like that about you? Nothing gets past me! No-siree!
: Except the fact that all of the sexual experience Kirin has been touting has apparently been about you! Silly Chika! But if you have found something to like about her, I’ll just have to believe it!
: Maybe she’s super tight? Maybe she makes cute noises or something? I don’t know! Guess I’ll find out soon, though! Please continue!
scene kirinxmad28
: Uhh...no thank you?
: Under normal circumstances, I’d be, like...all for this. But this is kind of a special moment that I don’t really want someone lurking in the corner for...
: Sensei supports it, though! Don’t you, Sensei?
scene kirinxmad29
: Sensei?...
: I’m not going to be able to make her leave, Kirin...
: What the fuck even is this?
: It’s...hard to explain.
: Not really!
scene kirinxmad27
: Sensei is my boyfriend! But he has an interesting, super-awesome take on love that allows him to “love” a whole bunch of people at one time! And you are one of those people!
: We made an agreement where he still gets to fuck them and stuff. But since I’m his actual love, I should probably be able to watch. Or join in! Just to make sure you’re doing everything correctly.

: You’re still totally special, though! So if you’re currently beating yourself up about how this doesn’t make you unique or that it isn’t “true love” or whatever, just stop. That’s, like...so immature. Right, Sensei?
scene kirinxmad30
: What the fuck is she going on about?...
: SPORK.
: Kirin...
: Maybe we should pick this back up after the Christmas party?

YOU ONLY THINK YOU LOVE HER
